requirement:
When preparing the mandatory input set defined by
{cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`, every terminology definition
referenced by the subject or any contributed source MUST contribute its complete
fenced declaration, including its phrase option. Definitions referenced by those
definitions MUST also be included transitively, without duplicates or
nontermination on cycles.

When an additional source read introduces a terminology dependency, the same
complete, transitive definition set MUST be supplied to the model and recorded
before accepting a submission.
rationale:
I found no gap in code or tests for any obligation.

**Obligations**
1. Every definition referenced by the subject or any contributed source contributes its complete fenced declaration, including its phrase option.
2. Definitions referenced by those definitions are included transitively.
3. The transitive set has no duplicates and does not fail to terminate on cycles.
4. When an additional source read introduces a terminology dependency, the same complete transitive set is supplied to the model.
5. That set is recorded before a submission is accepted.

**Code**
- **Initial set.** `src/authoring/inputs.rs#impl[AssessmentSources]/fn[prepare]` builds the mandatory inputs. It then calls `definition_inputs` with the contributed inputs and `Some(&subject.text)`, so the subject's own terms are included.
- **Direct references.** `definition_inputs` calls `src/terms.rs#fn[dependencies]`. That calls `direct_references`, which collects terms from the subject text. It also collects terms from each input: Requirements blocks, Rust and other outline comments, and Definition inputs.
- **Transitive closure.** `close_dependencies` expands the terms to a fixed point. Its `visited` set means each term is processed once and cycles terminate. The result is a `BTreeSet`, so it has no duplicates. `prepare` also skips any input already in `mandatory`.
- **Complete declaration.** `InputSelector::Definition` is resolved in `src/inputs.rs#impl[InputSelector]/fn[resolve]`. It uses the declaration's `raw_lines`, passed through `redact_lines`, so the whole fenced declaration with the `:phrase:` line is supplied. `to_input` emits it as `{definition, text}`.
- **Additional reads.**
  - `src/authoring/tools.rs#fn[read]` calls `sources.additional_definitions` and returns the definitions in the tool result. It adds them to the delivered inputs.
  - `src/authoring/pages.rs#impl[ResultPages]/fn[deliver]` does the same for paged results, per page through `definitions_each`.
  - `additional_definitions` runs the same `definition_inputs` closure. It filters out inputs already supplied or recorded.
- **Recording.** In `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[converse]`, `pending` holds the mandatory inputs plus every delivery's inputs, including definitions. `sources.record_inputs(&pending)` runs after each provider response and before submission handling, so the definitions are recorded before a submission is accepted.

**Tests**
- `src/authoring/inputs.rs#mod[tests]/fn[bundle_combines_direct_references_terms_and_current_existing_selectors]` covers a subject that references a term. The two terms reference each other, so it exercises a cycle. It asserts exactly two definition inputs, so there are no duplicates, and the transitive term is present.
- `src/authoring/inputs.rs#mod[tests]/fn[mandatory_git_inputs_require_staging_declarations_sources_and_terms]` covers a term referenced by a contributed source becoming a mandatory definition input.
- `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[definitions_introduced_by_a_read_are_supplied_and_recorded_before_submission]` covers an additional read that introduces a cyclic pair of terms.
  - The recorded evidence lists `terms.unit` and `terms.value` once each.
  - Each recorded text starts with `:::{definition}` and `:phrase: `.
  - The definition text appears in the second request, after the read, and not in the first.
- `src/authoring/tools.rs#mod[tests]/fn[reading_records_only_delivered_sources_and_their_terms]` covers item reads and line-range reads supplying and recording the terms.
- `src/authoring/pages.rs#mod[tests]/fn[paged_inputs_carry_their_definitions_and_deliver_only_their_own_inputs]` covers paged reads carrying their definitions.

I saw no unspecified behavior and no `{fixme}` references.

text: :::{req} authoring_inputs
When preparing the mandatory input set defined by
{cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`, every terminology definition
referenced by the subject or any contributed source MUST contribute its complete
fenced declaration, including its phrase option. Definitions referenced by those
definitions MUST also be included transitively, without duplicates or
nontermination on cycles.
When an additional source read introduces a terminology dependency, the same
complete, transitive definition set MUST be supplied to the model and recorded
before accepting a submission.
:::{req} mandatory_inputs
The harness MUST construct each assessment's mandatory input set by combining
the contributions specified by the requirements applicable to that subject and
its inputs. A requirement that contributes inputs MUST cite this requirement and
define which sources it contributes and when. The harness MUST include every
applicable contribution, deduplicate identical selections, and report
unresolvable mandatory inputs before inference. The complete set MUST be supplied
in the initial model request.
Generated output under project-root `evidence/`, including symlink aliases, MUST
be omitted from mandatory inputs when the default exclusion applies. An explicit
workspace allow MUST permit those selections; an explicit disallow MUST abort
under {cite}`requirements.authoring.read_denial.mandatory`.
